product_metadata.title: Arctic Tumblers | 30 oz Matte Pink Insulated Tumbler with Straw & Cleaner - Retains Temperature up to 24hrs - Non-Spill Splash Proof Lid, Double Wall Vacuum Technology, BPA Free & Built to Last
features: EXTREME TEMPERATURE RETENTION - The Arctic Tumblers double-wall vacuum technology maximizes temperature retention that traps the cold in your beverages for 16 hours and the heat for up to 8 hours! The thermal insulated design keeps the flavor and freshness of your drink while preventing any temperature transfer to the exterior. No matter what the contents - hot tea, coffee, or an ice-cold beverage, the feel on this stainless vacuum tumbler remains constant!

CONVENIENT & CUP HOLDER FRIENDLY – This slim tumbler is straw friendly and the base will fit most car, vehicle, bike, and boat cup holders and with a large 30 oz capacity, this stainless steel cup with straw is perfect for your coffee or extra-large cup of joe! Corners are rounded so there are no hard angles where dirt can hide. Easy to use, easy to clean, and best of all: environmentally green.

100% BPA FREE & SWEAT FREE BY DESIGN – No more coasters needed! The double wall insulation and high quality slip-free powder coat does not sweat on the outside, which allows you to conveniently keep a good grip on the tumbler while drinking on the go. Engineered with 18/8 kitchen & food grade stainless steel, our large insulated tumblers are durable, corrosion resistant and rust free. The lid is made from shatter resistant tritan material.

100% SATISFACTION GUARANTEE - If your Arctic tumbler thermal cup does not live up to your expectations, we'll get you another one or give you a FULL REFUND! As an Amazon-fulfilled seller, all sales can be returned hassle free within 30 days for any reason!

PRESENTED IN A PREMIUM GIFT BOX - Perfect for personal or corporate gifting. Delivered in an elegant gift packaging, you’ll be reluctant to give it away. Our premium standard tumblers are also available in packs of 4.
